indices.description: ndarray (Ni..., J, Nk...) Indices to take along each 1d slice of ``arr``. This must match the dimension of ``arr``, but dimensions Ni and Nj only need to broadcast against ``arr``.

axis.description: int or None, optional The axis to take 1d slices along. If axis is None, the input array is treated as if it had first been flattened to 1d, for consistency with `sort` and `argsort`.

output.description: ------- ndarray (Ni..., J, Nk...) The indexed result.
